reviews.review_text:
Steve
Sanur, Indonesia12 contributions

real hidden gem
Feb 2026 • Couples
This place is truly a hidden gem in Nha Trang. The restaurant is located on the top two floors above Circle K, accessed by a narrow corridor with vintage patterned tiles. A simple wooden staircase leads you upstairs, opening into an elegant space with a balcony and lush greenery where you can feel the sea breeze.

The food is beautifully crafted — from Mexican dishes and burgers to French-inspired cuisine. They also offer a great selection of local craft beers and various wines. It’s truly a delightful discovery, and definitely a place I’ll be visiting often.
